newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF says hopes NCB tie-up will ease worries.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF says hopes NCB tie-up will ease worries.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told reporters on Thursday that he hoped a planned tie-up between Japan's Nippon Credit Bank Ltd and Bankers Trust New York Corp of the United States would help solve financial uncertainties in Japan.
"I hope this (alliance) will help solve uncertainties in Japan's financial industry," he said.
Asked about current volatility in the currency market, he he replied: "We will watch it with interest."
Nippon Credit Bank and Bankers Trust said on Thursday they would sign a business alliance in late April. NCB said it was considering the possibility of a capital tie-up with the U.S. bank.
It did not elaborate on the possible equity tie-up.
